scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev --workspace backend" "npm run dev --workspace frontend"
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run build --workspace frontend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace backend && npm run lint --workspace frontend
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace backend && npm run test --workspace frontend
scripts.ci: npm run lint && npm run typecheck --workspace backend && npm run typecheck --workspace frontend && npm run test && npm run test:integration && npm run build
